name: WU World Championship
epitaph: Requiem won the first World title at See No Evil on 14 September 2008, beating DLS and Drake Daniels; the fed's own history page lists no defence and no loss.

name: WU One Shot Championship
epitaph: Called the Contender Championship at its start (Chad Vargas was the first Contender champion at See No Evil), then the One Shot Championship: Skull Daze, Twilight Rayn, Troy Gafgen and CJ Gates held it from October to December 2008. Five defences earned a World title shot; the only cash-in on record is Skull Daze's, helped by four defences the owner awarded him.
notes: The fed's page lists the first reign under the Contender name; the two names are taken as one belt because the page heads the list One Shot.

name: WU Short Circuit Championship
epitaph: David Gunn was the first Short Circuit champion at See No Evil; Porter MaCleod took it at The Bleeding on 19 October 2008 and the belt became the Prime Time Championship, once he had brought a belt from another federation and had it made official.
notes: The Bleeding's own commentary says 'it's still the Short Circuit championship... but it will become the Prime Time championship'; the Rankings page of 21 October lists a Prime Time champion.
